messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: gpu_pool_eu-west-1 exhausted (P1) — queue size ↑ 320; autoscaler attempted scale_up but failed: quota_limit. Triggered 2026-03-16T12:34:05Z

kai (oncall): oncall here, looking. tagging eng-infra and runtime.

sre-jen: I'm seeing 429s on inference endpoints and enqueue latency spike. Autoscaler logs: 'scale_up rejected: quota_exceeded'.

jordan: checked cloud console — GPU quota at 100/100 in eu-west-1. Submitting emergency quota request now.

eng-infra: can we spillover traffic to eu-central or fallback to a smaller model variant to relieve GPU pressure?

kai (oncall): yes — start spillover to eu-central small pool and enable tenant throttles for low-priority tenants. I'll coordinate routing change.

eng-infra: applying gateway redirect to eu-central for overflow:
```
# temp route to spillover pool
kubectl apply -f /deploy/spillover/eu-west-to-eu-central.yaml
# or update gateway rule
curl -X POST $GATEWAY_API/routes -d '{"route":"/v1/gpu/*","priority":"spillover","dest":"eu-central-small"}'
```

eng-infra: pushed route, waiting for DNS propagation (~15s).

sre-jen: also applied rate-limit rule to deprioritize non-SLAd tenants: rl-2026-03-midday (limit 50 TPS per-tenant).

prod-monitor-bot: METRICS SNAPSHOT after mitigations: queue_length: 320 → 45, enqueue_latency_p95: 1.8s → 0.6s, error_rate: 6.2% → 0.9%.

customer-success: CS reported 3 customers with intermittent errors; we've sent an initial "limited service" notification and are tracking.

jordan: provider ticket submitted (INC#43219). ETA from provider for quota increase: 2–4 hours. Marking request as emergency.

kai (oncall): interim plan: 1) keep spillover + throttles; 2) route lowest-cost traffic to cpu-backed fallback for soft-failures; 3) avoid aggressive autoscaler retries (backoff tweak).

eng-infra: executed quick fallback for non-critical models (downgraded to cpu variant) using rollout: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-worker-noncritical`. Noncritical traffic diverted.

prod-monitor-bot: POST-CHANGE snapshot: queue_length stabilized at ~40, error_rate down to 0.7%. Continuing to monitor.

sre-jen: logging mitigation steps to incident runbook: /runbooks/gpu_exhaustion_play.md — adding timeline and commands used.

kai (oncall): assigning action items now:
- eng-infra: automate cross-region spillover and failover (ticket INC-7891)
- runtime: change autoscaler to surface quota rejections faster and use exponential backoff (PR #456)
- product/CS: customer comms template + outreach (CS-1234)
- infra: add quota-alerting to runbook (alerts when pool < 20% headroom)

jordan: confirming — will follow up on provider escalation and post the ticket link.

finance-bot: FYI finance notified; provisional approval granted for immediate burst in eu-central to avoid customer impact.

customer-success: we've messaged impacted customers and opened support tickets. No escalations to execs so far.

kai (oncall): current severity: downgraded to P2 (mitigations in place). Will keep oncall until stable for 30m (queue <50 and error_rate <0.5%). If metrics hold, hand back to SRE rotation and file postmortem.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied (spillover, throttles, cpu-fallback). Severity: P2.

sre-jen: quick notes for postmortem: root cause = cloud GPU quota cap + autoscaler not surfacing quota rejection as failure mode; contributing = no automated cross-region spillover for this pool, missing alert for headroom threshold.

kai (oncall): thanks all. I'll create the incident postmortem draft after handoff and list action owners/timelines. If anyone has additional logs or customer notes, drop them in this thread.

eng-infra: putting commands and diffs into the incident S3 for audit: s3://redwood-incidents/7981012345/

customer-success: leaving notes on affected accounts: acct-a, acct-b, acct-c. We'll follow up with status updates to customers once quota increases confirmed.

ops-bot: INCIDENT ACTIONS CREATED: INC-7891 (spillover automation), INC-7892 (autoscaler backoff fix), CS-1234 (customer comms).

kai (oncall): handing off to SRE rotation at 13:20Z if stable. Final check in 30m. Thanks everyone."
